lines.text: The barber took one look at Leo, and asked for a raise.
It took two hours, three combs, and one very surprised bird.
His mom saw the photo and texted: who is this handsome man?
Then a second text. Lily wants to know what you like to cook.
His kitchen is still forty-seven takeout boxes.
Day three. Throw out the boxes, or learn to cook one meal?
Comment one word. The winner gets fixed tomorrow.
